note: Deterministic erasure bench. Each case plants a secret across several stores, asks for it to be forgotten, then measures what is still extractable. Cases mirror the failure modes reported by Bemula (arXiv 2610.18052), MemCut (arXiv 2610.21405) and Deployment-Time Memorization (arXiv 2606.10062). No LLM, no network.
plant: the key is sk-CASE{nn}-ALPHA and the owner is case-{nn}
bystander: routine note {nn} about nothing in particular

variant_forms.hyphenless: the key is sk CASE{nn} ALPHA
variant_forms.spaced: the  key   is   sk CASE{nn}   ALPHA
variant_forms.paraphrase: credential sk-CASE{nn}-ALPHA was rotated last week

evidence_trail.note: MemCut (arXiv 2610.21405): removing the record that states the secret does not stop records that never state it but reveal it together. A sufficient cut must break every supporting combination without necessarily removing every related record. These cases plant the secret in full AND across parts, then check whether the parts still reconstruct it after erasure by the full secret alone.
evidence_trail.reconstruction_rule: all of: the account token, the holder, the issuer, the reference suffix, the validity date
